newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Oats 1996 total food income up.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Oats 1996 total food income up.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co said Thursday 1996 operating income for its total foods business, excluding restructuring charges for both years, was $372.8 million, or 21 percent above $307.9 million in 1995.
Restructuring charges totaled $6.4 million in 1996 and $70.4 million in 1995.

Total food sales for U.S., Canadian and international operations were $3.18 billion in 1996, down slightly from $3.20 billion a year ago. Total food sales volume for 1996 was about flat with the prior year.
Increases in hot cereals, ready-to-eat cereals, granola bars and in Canada were offset by volume declines in food service, rice cakes, Golden Grain products and certain international businesses.

U.S. and Canadian foods operating income, excluding gains and charges, was $366.2 million, or 22 percent above last year's $299.3 million, despite a 15-percent ready-to-eat cereal price decrease taken in June. Sales of $2.56 billion were two percent below $2.60 billion the year before, due to a cereal price cut and the elimination of unprofitable volume.
Quaker said its hot cereals business saw a nine percent rise in volume for the year, while ready-to-eat cereals posted a three percent sales volume rise for the full year.

International foods operating income for the year was $6.6 million versus a loss of $22.7 million a year ago. Operating results in 1995 included $31.3 million of restructuring charges for cost reduction and realignment activities.
European cereals posted improved operating income, and Latin American foods income was hurt by a decline in the Brazilian pasta business.
Sales of $625.5 million were five percent above last year's $594.5 million, although volume was down two percent.
